QUESTION:
Which setting can I use to deactivate the backup mechanism that freezes the state of queues completely?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0872] config | snapshotter.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `snapshotter.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

---

[d0115] config | snapshotter.enabled | version 4.x
# `snapshotter.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.enabled` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
enabled = true
```

---

- New option `quota.enabled`: turns the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant on or off.

- New option `spool.batch_size`: number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.

- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.

- New option `snapshotter.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

- New option `retention.log_level`: log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

[d0016] config | snapshotter.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `snapshotter.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `snapshotter.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
threshold_percent = 75
```

---

response.content: In PaderQueue 4.x, set `snapshotter.enabled = false` under `[snapshotter]` in `paderqueue.toml`.
